VALIDATION COMMANDS: NO CI pipeline exists (.github has no workflows - only agents/ + skills/). Unity tests run through Unity Test Framework in the real editor via MCP run_tests/get_test_job async tools; there is NO powershell Unity test-runner. Compile/refresh before trusting results (see /memories/repo/unity-branch-switch-stale-assemblies). dotnet STATIC COMPILE CHECK works WITHOUT the editor running: root .csproj files (ProceduralCreature.Runtime.csproj, ProceduralCreature.Editor.csproj, ProceduralCreature.Tests.Runtime.csproj, ProceduralCreature.Tests.Editor.csproj, Assembly-CSharp.csproj, Assembly-CSharp-Editor.csproj) are Unity-generated and hard-reference the installed editor D:\Program Files\Unity\6000.5.9f1\Editor\Data\Managed\UnityEngine\UnityEngine.dll (+ UnityEditor.dll). Command: dotnet build <csproj> --no-restore. Caveats: it is NOT a substitute for Unity execution and depends on that fixed install path. Also run git diff --check after edits.

MEMORYSMITH OPS (CreatureCreator wiki): service = "MemorySmith - CreatureCreator Wiki", HTTP port 7916 (fallback 4279); engine published from D:\@Repos\MemorySmith (MemorySmith.App.csproj) to artifacts/MemorySmith.App/. Scripts (Scripts/): Deploy-CreatureWiki.ps1 (publish+install+start, admin; -NoBuild reinstall), Bootstrap-CreatureWikiEngine.ps1 (publish only), Stop/Get/Uninstall-CreatureWikiService.ps1, Test-TaskRecords.ps1 (validate Data/Tasks/*.json contract), Normalize-TaskRecords.ps1, Import-OpenTasksFromWorkbench.ps1, Import-CreatureTasksToMemorySmith.ps1 (creates TSK-#### via memorysmith_task_create, state in .service/memorysmith-import-state.json, auth cookie from $env:MEMORYSMITH_AUTH_COOKIE). Data/ layout: Memories/ (Core, Working, Unconsolidated, Deprecated), Pages/ (workbench/tasks.md + empty assets/), Tasks/ (tsk-####-slug.json), Models/ (ONNX embedding - MISSING, so semantic provider unavailable -> lexical-only search), vars.json (empty), Events/, Graph/, Keys/ (runtime). MCP server exposed as mcp_memorysmithwi_memorysmith_*.

MEMORYSMITH RECORD CONTRACT (for authored memories): record = one JSON file <Id>.json in the folder matching its Status. FileMemoryStore loads all *.json under Data/Memories recursively; corrupt files skipped. Fields: Id, Content, Title, Status (int 0 Unconsolidated / 1 Working / 2 Core / 3 Deprecated), Confidence (double), Tags[], References[], Conflicts[], Relationships[], SourceLinks[] (Label, Uri, optional StartLine/EndLine; Uri may contain %Variable% tokens), UsageCount, LastUpdated (ISO). MCP memory_create requires Agent auto_accept approval mode (disabled in this environment) - author record files directly as the fallback, matching this schema exactly. Memory state machine thresholds (MemoryStateMachine): Unconsolidated->Working score>=0.81; Working->Core >=1.62; Core->Working demotion <1.62; Working->Deprecated <0.16; Unconsolidated never deprecates directly. Core = authoritative current knowledge agents should prefer. Data/Memories = durable current-state facts/rules; Data/Pages = longer notes/design/roadmaps (future plans belong in pages, not memories).

ADR INVENTORY (docs/adr/): ADR-001 limbchain schema + CreaturePart as semantic container (CC-018); ADR-002 composable geometry + GeneratedCreature output (CC-031); ADR-003 material palette/submaterial resolution AND ADR-003 rest-space geometry binding (two ADR-003 files); ADR-004 per-shape parameters/legacy migration AND ADR-004 position-only pose rotation (two ADR-004 files); ADR-005 runtime rig hierarchy + pose application; ADR-006 shared generation configuration; ADR-007 resolved morphology model (CC-056A/056B); ADR-008 MemorySmith task + memory adoption. (ADR-003/004 numbering is duplicated/inconsistent across files.)
